## Crossfade

True crossfade between tracks in the stock **Music** app — one song fades out as the next fades in. Works on your **local library** (owned files), so no subscription is needed.

Adjustable fade length in Settings → Crossfade.

**A12 and newer: supported and confirmed.** Earlier builds put A12+ devices (iPhone XS / XR and later) into safe mode; the current builds are made with Xcode's toolchain and are tested on a real A12+ device.

- Tested on an **iPhone SE (2nd gen, A13)** with iOS 17.5.1 (arm64e) and an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11)** with iOS 16.7, both with Dopamine. On iOS 17 it installs and loads cleanly; crossfading wasn't re-checked there (no local music on the test phone).
- **If it ever puts you into safe mode:** open Sileo (safe mode still allows it), uninstall it and please [report back](https://github.com/Jond-ie/repo/issues).

- **Local library only.** Apple Music streaming tracks are DRM-protected and out of scope — they won't crossfade.
- Requires **ellekit** (Dopamine).
- Tested on an **iPhone 8 Plus (A11, arm64)** with iOS 16.7. A12 and newer: see Device Support.
